title: ～に — time, destination, place of existence
summary: A particle for a point in time, a destination, the place where something exists, and the target of an action. It attaches to nouns.

patterns.form: 場所＋に＋あります／います
patterns.gloss: place + に + あります / います

body.p: It marks a point in time: 七時に, 日曜日に. It is not used with 今日, 毎日 or いつも.
へ in 山へ行きます can be replaced by に. The place where something is takes に: 机の上に本があります.
The place where an action happens takes で; the place where something exists takes に.

examples.ja: 七時（しちじ）に起（お）きます。
日曜日（にちようび）に山（やま）へ行（い）きます。
examples.tr: I go to the mountain on Sunday.

examples.ja: 机（つくえ）の上（うえ）に本（ほん）があります。
examples.romaji: Tsukue no ue ni hon ga arimasu.
examples.tr: There is a book on the desk.

pitfalls: Do not say 毎日に or 今日に.
Distinguish に and で: existence takes に, action takes で.
